title: NG Audit — Client × Shift Status Matrix

panels.title: Total Customers
panels.description: All unique customers ever onboarded (all-time, not filtered by time range)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT uniqExact(client_name) AS total_customers
FROM vusmart.ng_audit_summary_distributed

panels.title: # Customer Data Received
panels.description: Customers that sent audit data in the selected time range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT uniqExact(client_name) AS reporting
FROM vusmart.ng_audit_summary_distributed
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

panels.title: # Customers with P1
panels.description: Customers with at least one P1 failure in the selected time range. Click to see which customers.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT uniqExact(client_name) AS p1_customers
FROM vusmart.ng_audit_summary_distributed
WHERE p1_fail_count > 0
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

panels.title: # Customers with P2
panels.description: Customers with at least one P2 failure in the selected time range. Click to see which customers.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT uniqExact(client_name) AS p2_customers
FROM vusmart.ng_audit_summary_distributed
WHERE p2_fail_count > 0
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

panels.title: Client × Shift Status Matrix
panels.description: Green = PASS  |  Orange = P2 failure only  |  Red = P1 failure  |  Grey = no data. Click any cell to open the detail dashboard for that shift.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  client_name,
  toString(date) AS audit_date,
  shift,
  overall_status,
  p1_fail_count,
  p2_fail_count
FROM vusmart.ng_audit_summary_distributed
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 2 DAY
ORDER BY audit_date DESC, client_name, shift

panels.title: P1 — Affected Customers
panels.description: One row per customer. P1 count = distinct failing check types. If the same check failed in BOD and EOD it counts once. Click a customer to open their latest audit.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  client_name,
  uniqExact(metrics_type) AS p1_count,
  toString(max(date)) AS latest_date
FROM vusmart.ng_audit_checks_distributed
WHERE priority = 'P1'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY client_name
ORDER BY p1_count DESC

panels.title: P2 — Affected Customers
panels.description: One row per customer. P2 count = distinct failing check types. If the same check failed in BOD and EOD it counts once. Click a customer to open their latest audit.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  client_name,
  uniqExact(metrics_type) AS p2_count,
  toString(max(date)) AS latest_date
FROM vusmart.ng_audit_checks_distributed
WHERE priority = 'P2'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY client_name
ORDER BY p2_count DESC

SELECT

panels.title: P1 Persistence — How Long Each Issue Has Been Active
panels.description: Shows how many days each P1 check type has been continuously failing per customer within the selected time range. A high 'Active Days' count means the issue has not been resolved across multiple audit runs.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  client_name,
  metrics_type,
  toString(min(date)) AS first_seen,
  toString(max(date)) AS last_seen,
  uniqExact(date) AS active_days
FROM vusmart.ng_audit_checks_distributed
WHERE priority = 'P1'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY client_name, metrics_type
ORDER BY active_days DESC, client_name
